lighthouse.alt: Brush-and-ink drawing on white paper: a tall lighthouse drawn in broken, skipping strokes, standing on rough rocks above one long sweep of shoreline, with a loose cloud drifting to its right.
lighthouse.caption: the lighthouse. brush and ink.
lighthouse.permission: flor, 2026-10-24: 'To the git! Add the art.' committed, public, metadata stripped.

house-band.alt: Brush-and-ink sketch: two heads face each other over a snare drum. The left one is round and calm with a pointed nose; the right one has a spiky shock of hair like a crash cymbal, with a cymbal stand between them. Black strokes on white paper.
house-band.caption: the house band. brush and ink.
house-band.permission: flor, 2026-10-24: 'To the git! Add the art.' committed, public, metadata stripped. lives beside the museum page, which looks for it there.

the-pour.alt: Coloured-pencil drawing on a sketchbook page: a coupe glass outlined twice, once in yellow and once in red, filled with loose brown scribble, standing a little off-plumb on a wide foot. Faint earlier drawings show through the paper.
the-pour.caption: the pour. coloured pencil.
the-pour.permission: flor, 2026-10-24: 'To the git! Add the art.' committed, public, metadata stripped. lives beside the museum page, which looks for it there.

back-room.alt: Brush-and-ink sketch of a crammed room: a fireplace with a grate at the left under shelves of books and bottles, a tall window at the right with trees and a path outside, a teapot on a stand in the middle, and a low table drawn in the foreground. Quick black strokes on white paper.
back-room.caption: the back room. brush and ink.
back-room.permission: flor, 2026-10-24: 'To the git! Add the art.' committed, public, metadata stripped. lives beside the museum page, which looks for it there.

two-lilies.alt: Coloured-pencil drawing: a white lily outlined in blue and violet with orange stamens, on a long green stem with a closed bud and one leaf, standing in a squat bottle scribbled orange, green and blue. A second lily, smaller and lower, opens at the right edge of the page.
two-lilies.caption: two lilies. coloured pencil.
two-lilies.permission: flor, 2026-10-24: 'To the git! Add the art.' committed, public, metadata stripped. lives beside the museum page, which looks for it there.

the-creek.alt: Digital drawing on canary-yellow paper, thirty seconds into a two-minute video: a curly-haired figure in profile drawn in sand-colored lines, eyes closed, a green blade of grass between their lips, one arm reaching to the right. A green frame of straight lines and two loops stands in front of them. The sun in the top right is still only a pale ring, and at the bottom right the word whistle has two letters so far, wh, in green.
the-creek.caption: the creek, in her hand. the thirty-second frame of a video, not done, but something.
the-creek.permission: flor, 2026-11-03: 'throw it in there if you want. i might forget.' then: 'you'll have to pick from a frame because the last one doesn't do it justice. which frame is your favorite?' the desk picked the thirty-second frame of her video of 2026-10-31 (captured from the player, metadata stripped). the video itself stays in her iCloud; the stage holds only the still.

town-icon.alt: An orange sunburst of short radiating strokes in the top right corner of canary-yellow paper, with a line of blue cloud at the left edge.
town-icon.caption: the icon: her sun, from the corner of the creek.
town-icon.permission: flor, 2026-11-03: 'peep the sun. i think you'd like the shape. i'd love an icon for the town.' cropped from the creek video by the desk; the app icon on the napkin and on the stage's three pages. hers to swap for a doodle of her own.
